settings.heading: Privacy Policy
settings.content:
Last updated: May 2026 — a starting template, not legal advice. Tailor to your jurisdiction (GDPR/CCPA) before launch.

Prairie Fat Co. respects your privacy. This explains what we collect and why.

What we collect

  • Order info: name, address, email, phone, payment details (processed securely — we never store full card numbers).
  • Account info: login and order history.
  • Usage data: pages visited, device/browser, cookies.

How we use it

  • To process and ship orders and provide support.
  • To send order updates and, if you opt in, marketing.
  • To improve our products and prevent fraud.

Sharing

Only with service providers who help us operate. We do not sell your personal data.

Your rights

Email privacy@prairiefatco.example to access, correct, delete or port your data.
